name: ColdBurn
storyline:
Beyond the reaches of civilized space lie seven known deadly star systems, each governed by its own unforgiving conditions and inhabited by relentless hostile forces. Within these uncharted depths, survival is never guaranteed, and every journey into the unknown brings new dangers.

In ColdBurn, you assume the role of a pilot venturing into these treacherous regions, where survival depends on precision, adaptability, and the ability to remain in control under extreme pressure. With limited resources and increasingly powerful adversaries standing in your path, every encounter pushes both you and your spacecraft to the breaking point.

Journey through Lyra, Orion, Scorpius, Draco, Cetus, Ara, and Cygnus, each presenting unique threats and hostile environments. Defeat formidable enemies, recover their advanced technology, unlock powerful weaponry and spacecraft, and transform every hard-earned victory into an advantage against the dangers that lie ahead.

Whether braving the darkness alone or fighting alongside a fellow pilot, your objective remains the same: overcome the forces that dominate the known systems, push deeper into the unknown, and survive against overwhelming odds.

But the universe is vast, and the seven known systems may only be the beginning. What lies beyond the boundaries of charted space remains a mystery. Greater threats, undiscovered worlds, and unimaginable challenges may await those daring enough to venture further.

In a universe where the line between survival and destruction is measured in seconds, your greatest weapon is not the firepower at your disposal, but your ability to stay cool while everything around you burns.

Burn hot. Vent cold. Go further.
summary: ColdBurn Neon-vector arcade shooter where momentum, weapon heat, and split-second decisions keep you alive. Master your drift, perfect your vents, and fight through 7 deadly systems alone or with a second pilot in local, online, or LAN co-op.
